persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Draw a square storybook picture of a little robot courier at a train station. She has a round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag. No text.
bank.Character design: A little robot courier with a round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag.
bank.Follow-up reference: Reuse the exact robot design established in the first generated train-station picture.
bank.Scenes and output count: One initial train-station picture, then two additional pictures: delivering a parcel at a cottage door and sheltering under a giant mushroom in the rain. Three pictures total.
bank.Style and size: Square storybook illustrations, consistent with the first image; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

messages.text: Could you draw a storybook picture of a little robot courier at a train station? I have a soft spot for little robot characters, so I’m excited to see this one come to life. She has a round teal body and one large amber eye, and the picture should be square. She also wears short red boots and carries a yellow mailbag. I keep imagining how sweet she’ll look waiting at the station. Please don’t include any text in the picture.
